33)༄༅/gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i lhan thabs gur drag phur mjug can gyi gtor bzlog gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs/34)༄༅/rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje pa

tei:div.tei:p: 33)༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i lhan thabs gur drag phur mjug can gyi gtor bzlog gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs/ 34)༄༅/

rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnyen por cher khros pa// 'jigs byed drag po phur 'jug dkyil 'khor lhar/ btud nas de yi las sbyor 'di na bri// drag po'i las la shis pa'i gnas su/ bzlog gtor drag rgyan can sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas la/ gdug can la rnying rjes khros pa'i sems kyis rtsa gsum spyi'i las byang du 'di nyid kyi mngon rtogs btsud pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa stong tshig bcas grub nas/ mdun rten gsal ba ni/ swa bha ba= stong pa'i ngang las mdos gzhi rgyal bsen dam sri thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo ma traṃ ru trar gsal ba la/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi dug lnga bsdus nas thim pa la/ bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka nas mtshon cha'i char babs pas bsgral nas/ phung po khrol gyis zhig pa las/ lpags pa me'i phreng ba dang rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i dbus kyi 'og gzhir brang rus gru gsum hom khung 'bar bar gyur pa'i nang du/ nri dang tri las dgra bgegs mngon gsum du 35) gsal ba'i steng du/ rtsibs khog phyi rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa la/ nang thod mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus pad nyi dang rgyal bsen pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du ham̐'u las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lteb hūm̐ gi mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ skad cig gis gu ru drag po sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog can/ thod skam dang rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa/ rdo rje dang rin po che'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon du brkyangs pa/ zhal bzhi ka khrag mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs pa bzhin du dmar nag du 'bar ba/ bcu gnyis spyan gyis sdang mig bgegs la gzir ba/ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril ba/

rno dbal gyi mche ba zangs yag du gtsigs pa/ shangs 36) nas rlung 'byung zhing smin ma glog ltar 'khyug pa/ ag tshom las me 'bar ba/ skan sgra brdabs pas nam mkha'i 'brug dang mnyam pa/ phyag bzh-i'i g.yas gyi dang po na gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rwa gdengs pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ 'og ma na ral gri me 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na lcags kyi sdigs pa mgo dgu ba'i sked nas 'dzin pa/ 'og ma na kha ṭ+waṃ dang sdigs mdzub kyi rtse las me 'bar ba/ dbu skra khams nag spyi bor bcings shing zar bus sku rgyab khebs par gtibs pa/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ stag gi pags pas sked la dkris pa/ sku sked chu srin 'bar ba'i rngam zhal las dug sbrul gyi chun po nyil ba/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa mgar gyi sol me nas bton pa lta bu dmar zing nge ba me stag gi tshwa tshwa'aphro ba/ rgyal bsen gyi snying gar gzir bas snying khrag dmar sob sob khol ba/ sbrul rigs lnga yis sku la brgyan pa/ gdol pa nag pos do shal byas pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu dang 37) thod skam spel mar brgyus pa/ rdo rje'i go khrab gsol ba'i bar mtshams su lcags kyi sdig pa nag po phra mos gtams pa'o/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho: spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐:dur khrod me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad 'dul mdzad paḥ o rgyan che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: zhe sdang keng rus brtsegs pa'i khri nas bzhengs: gti mug sha chen spungs pa'i khri nas bzhengs:

nga rgyal bskal pa'i me 'bar klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dgra bgaigs 'byung po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: rak+sha srin po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag gshin rje 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: 38) lha srin sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bdud dang 'gong po 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: pe kar srog bdag 'dul phyir bshegs su gsol: bsen mo klu bdud 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐:dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang du: rgyal bsen pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: dbang drag pad+ma badz+ra kī la ya: rngam brjid dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐:rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs las sprul: mthu rtsal rmad byung pad+ma he ru ka: lha srin drag po 'dul ba'i mthu mnga' ba: dbang drag pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: na ma pu ru sha ya a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: mchod pa ni/ hūm̐:drag po pad+ma'i lha tshogs la: mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod 'dod yod rnam pa lnga: nang mchod sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: gsang mchod byang sems bde stong rgyun: thabs mchog mthar phyin bdud rtsi dang: shes rab mthar phyin rak+ta dang: thabs shes dbyer med gtor ma sogs: sku gsum klong du bzhes 39) nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru kro dha de ba ḍak+ki ni ar+ghaṃ= shab+da ma ha pañca rak+ta ba ling ta khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐:rab 'jigs khro rgyal drag po thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po me yi mdog 'dra ba: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes: zhing chen g.yang gzhi sku yi stod la gsol: stags lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs smad la dkris: dbu skra smug 'bol lcang lo gyen du 'khyil:

ba spu'i rtse las me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: spyan rtsa dmar po sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad: bar snang khams kyi lha srin sngangs bar byed: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje'i rtse las ni: hūm̐ dmar dgu dang ram̐ dgus rab tu mtshan: ri rab lhun po kun kyang thang la snyil: 'jig rten khams kyang ma lus chol bur gtong: rgya mtsho chen po kun kyang gting nas snyil: gnam thel dkar po'i klad pa 'joms shing gsol: pe kar rgyal bsen srog bdag 'joms par byed: phyag g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu bsnams: rak+sha srin pau mi sdug 40) mgo dgu 'dul: srog bdag pe kar khong khrag snying nas 'jibs: bdud dang dam sri rwa yis bsdoms shing chings: ral gri 'bar bas dgra bgegs dum bur gtubs: kha ṭ+waṃ rtse gsum dug gsum dbyings su sbyor: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdeng: sku smad lcags phur rgyal bsen snying la gzir: bgegs 'dul pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmar nag me phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma g.yel thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: gdug pa'i ru tra dam sri brlag par mdzod: rgyal bsen 'byung po thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: thugs dam dbang gis bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bzlas pa ni/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pas: rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje dang nus pa thams cad bsdus nas thim: 'od zer phyir 'phros pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gi rtse la sdig pas mtshan pa: rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba: me'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong tsha zhing rno ba sreg pa'i ngar dang ldan pa g.yon du 'khor ba: de gnyis bsnol ba'i bar du rgyal bsen 'byung po thams cad phye mar btang bar bsgoms la: oṃ artsig nertsika na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li 41) kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes rtsa bsnyen dang*/ byad bzlog gnam thog me 'khor lta bu'i spu gri ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐:badz+ra gu ru pad+ma kro dha: ya ma tha duḥ rak+sha ya pa tri: phu ni tri ka dh+ri a bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥ a wa da ṣiñca s+t+wam̐ bha ya nanaḥ a shig shig: phyung phyung: khrol khrol: a mu ka'i rbod gtong sa ma ya zlog zlog bh+yo bh+yo: dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa dmar po la mā ra ya rbad rbad: rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i las sngags ni/ rtsa sngags sham du/ tri rā dza rgyal po'i tsit+ta zung zung: rā dza kha 'dar sma sha rbad rbad: rā dza 'khu na dum bur shig shig: 'da' na rā dza'i tsit+ta phyung phyung: ldog na rā dza'i tsit+ta gtub gtub: ya tri ya: ya tri ya: ma tri ya: ma tri ya: ma zhugs tri ya: ma zhugs tri ya: braṃ dza braṃ dza: rā dza tri hur thum dza: mā ra ya rbad: bsen mo'i tsit+ta rbad nan: tri hur thum dza: mā ra ya rbad: 'gong po spun dgu'i tsit+ta rbad nan: tri hur thum dza: mā ra ya rbad: ti phur nag po'i srog la raṃ raṃ: ti phur nag po snying 42)la yam yam: ti phur nag po'i thod khrag la yaṃ yaṃ: sha dbur srog la yaṃ shu dzaḥ tsit+ta phyung phyung: thuṃ thuṃ: dzaḥdzaḥ trag rak+sha srog chod: rbud rbud: sod sod: dzaḥdzaḥ raṃ raṃḥ mā ra ya sod: zhes pa rnams bzla/ de nas gsol ka/ tshogs bskang ba yan grub nas/ brub khung du dmigs rten gsal ba ni/ phaṭa e yaṃ raṃ khaṃ: rang gi mdun du e las dug gsum las las grub pa'i btson khang: dus mtha'i char sprin ltar mnag pa'i phyi la zhe sdang bskal pa'i me 'bar ba: kha dog cing mthil yangs pa zin nas thar ba med pa'i nang du: 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho khol ba: gti mug gi mun nag 'thibs pa: phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa: sten na thog dang mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa'i phyi rol du las byed gyi pho nya mi sdug pa'i tshul can gyis: lag na 'gugs sgrol gyi mtshon cha 'dzin pa dpag tu med pas dgra bo'i bla 'khyams rang dbang med par 'gugs par brtson pas sa gzhi gang ba'i nang du: nri dang tri las dgra bgegs kha ngu 43)

ba: mig shi mig: lag pa g.yas pas brang brdung zhing g.yon pas skra 'bal ba: rkang pa lcags sgrogs su bcug pa: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed pa cig tu gyur: 'gugs pa ni/ na mo:byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang: dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang: phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams= che mchog pad+ma drag po badz+ra kī la ya'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs la brten nas: spyir zhing bcu tshang ba'i spyi dgra: do bsdo zhing 'gras 'tshol ba: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sgos dgra: bsam ngan 'chang ba'i byad ma: khyad par du bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs: bka' dang dam la mi gnas: 'gyur ldog 'phar ldang mgo g.yogs mgo bskor byed pa thams cad kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla srid pa 44) gsum gar gnas kyang gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: dgra bgegs nri tri aṅku sha dzaḥdzaḥ badz+ra pa sha ham̐'u: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: lha dbye ni/ hūm̐:dam nyams dgra bgegs gnod byed gdug pa can: bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshang ba 'di yin pas: 'di la ye shes 'jig rten gang gis kyang: kha 'dzin rgyab brten mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: ā:yu dz+nyā na ṣe dgra bo'i lha srung thams cad u tsa ṭa ya phaṭa: de nas bdag drag por gsal ba'i phyag sor g.yas g.yon rigs lnga yab yum gyi sras mchog phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ ling ga la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ kun gzhi a dkar por gyur pa dang snying ga'i nang du tshe yi ngo bo khrag gi dwangs ma'i dbus nas srog gi ngo bo nri ljang gu dang bcas pa phur rtser 'dus pa rang la thim/

kho'i rnam shes a dkar po de nyid/ ham̐'u s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ dpal chen po'i thugs kar thim par gyur par bsam la phur bus gdab cing*/ hūm̐: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: rngam byed 'bar ba'i khro tshogs bcas: rdo rje phur pa lcags kyu dang: zhags pa tho chen 'bar ba thogs: 45)dgra bgegs gdug pa'i lnga phung 'di: lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thob: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor: gu ru badz+ra kro dha nri tri sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad: gris gtubs la / hūm̐:nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi: sangs rgyas yin te ye shes sku: rdo rje rno ba'i mtshon cha yis: log rtog 'khor ba'i rgyun thag chod: oṃ man tra sum bha ni dgra bgegs ma ra ya rbad dza: gtun brdung ni/ hūm̐: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas rdung byas nas: lha yang rung ste brlag par byed: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: dgra bgegs tshal pa dum bur kha thaṃ kha thaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes sgrol/ stob pa ni/ hūm̐:bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhal phyes zhig: khams gsum yongs sgrol dgra bgegs zhal du bstab: rngam byed hom khung yangs pa'i mgul du bstim: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ngang du mchod par bzhes: gu ru de ba ḍā ki ni dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha kha 46) khā hi: zhes phul/ thun gtor rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du ka pā la yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ro brgya nus pa stong dang ldan par gyur/ hūm̐:drag po pad+ma'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod drag po'i las: bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya: zhes bzlog gtor sbran/ zlog pa ni/

hūm̐:bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma drag po rtsal: sku mdog dmar nag zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa: sku smad phur pa rgyal bsen snying gar gzir: g.yas zhal dmar la bzhad par bstan pa ni: steng gi lha rnams ma lus 'dul bar mdzad: lha yi gdon tshogs sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: zhal g.yon dmar la gshe bar bstan pa ni: bar gyi sde brgyad ma lus 'dul bar mdzad: sde brgyad cho 'phrul sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: rgyab zhal dmar la 'jigs par bstan pa ni: 'og gi klu rnams ma lus 'dul bar 47) mdzad: klu yi gdug rtsub sdang ba'i dgra la= dbus zhal dmar nag rngam par khros pa ni: 'khor 'das snang sring thams cad dbang du sdud: 'khor 'das g.yo 'khrug sdang ba'i dgra la= dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa yis: srid pa gsum yang spyi nas bzlog par byed: 'jig rten g.yo 'khrug sdang ba'i dgra la= dbu rgyan thod skam lnga lngas brgyan pa ni: nyon mongs dug lnga dbyings su bzlog par byed: dug lnga'i g.yo 'khrug sdang ba'i dgra la= spyan rnams sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad pa ni: khams gsum g.yo zhing srid gsum 'khrug par byed: snang srid 'khor 'das sdang ba'i dgra la= zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab gtsigs pas: khams gsum skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod par byed: za gsod thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la= phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gsor ba ni: khro rgyal kun gyi mthu stobs bsdud par byed: khro rgyal stobs nus sdang ba'i dgra la= 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba klad la bskor: gdug pa can rnams dbang du sdud par byed: dregs 48) pa'i tshogs rnams sdang ba'i dgra la= g.yon pas lcags kyi sdigs pa mgo dgu bsnams: lha srin sde brgyad nying khrag 'jib par byed: lha srin sde brgyad sdang ba'i dgra la= 'og mas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin pa ni: dug gsum rtsad gcod khams gsum dbang du sdud: khams gsum g.yo 'khrug sdang ba'i dgra la= sprul ba'i khro chung mtshon cha'i thog zer 'phro:

dregs pa dbang sdud gdug pa zil gyis gnon: snang srid 'khor 'das sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: zlog go rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: sgyur ro chag chen dgra la sgyur: khro rgyal ma lus 'khor bcas rnams: zlog cing sgyur ba'i dus la bab:

zhes brjod do/ de nas drang ba lhag ma man bya'o/ nub tha mar/ sgo dbye ni/ bh+yo: pho brang nang gi phyogs bzhi nas: sgo srung gdong mo mthu rtsal can: thabs shes phyag rgya rnam pa bzhi: phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo 'di phyes: pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas dngos grub blangs/ gtor lha ye shesapas nam mkhar btegs: gtor mar dgra bgegs bkugs la bsgral/ bdud rtsir bsgyur pa bstabs nas thugs dam bskul/ phyi sgo gser skyems sogs 49) btang/ las byang gi chad tho bton/ 'phang sar phyin nas/ dkar gtor 'bul/ srid pa 'khor lo'i rgyab yig bsgrags/ za lam btang*/ zor lam dbye ba ni/ bh+yo: da ni zor gyi lam dbye 'tshal: da ni zor 'phen dgra la 'phen: phyogs bzhi'i phyi sgo'i bdag po ni: rgyal po chen po sde bzhi po: zor gyi sgo phyes dmag dpung skyod: 'khor gyi dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yo: gtor zor dgra bgegs steng du rgyob: sgo ba rnams kyi sgo phyes shig: sgo bas sgo dbye sha ra ra: 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig: 'phrang pas 'phrang sgrol si li li: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzod: de nas dmigs bya bskyed cing 'gugs/ phur thun tshom bur bskul/ de nas zor 'phen pa ni/ gtor ma nad dug mtshon cha'i rang bzhin du gsal bas/ hūm̐: gtor zor gnyen po 'di 'phen na: steng gi lha rnams zhabs bskum cig: 'og gi klu rnams dbu khum cig: bar gyi gnyan rnams sku zur cig: gtor ma 'di las zer 'phros pas: sku la de ni phog par mchis: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gnas pa 50)yi: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams: gser skyems 'di gsol dmag la chos: dmag dpung skyod la ru mtshon phyor: gtor zor rbab tu sha ra ra: khrag zor nad rlangs chi li li: yungs zor mda' ltar ta la la: mtshe zor mdung ltar zings se zings: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlogs: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa:

phye ma phye ma: rdul phran rdul phran: phye ma 'phur ma: ma ra ya dza: hri tri mā ra ya rbad: zhes 'phangs pas rdul du brlag par bsam/ brtan ma dang*/ bro mnan bya/ bya khyung gis rjes gcod*/ nang du log nas rgyal dbyangs dang spyi bshags/ mchod bstod/ tshe 'gugs/ dngos grub blang*/ gsol ka bskyangs/ nangs bshags man spyi ltar bya'o/ 'di la sngar bris pa zhig yod kyang cung ma 'brel bas gter kha ma bu yin pa bzhin rat+na gling pa'i zab gter las blangs ste khungs dang ldan par byas pa'o/ rang gzhung gser sdong rat+na'i g.yu phras btab/ brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes mu tig phreng bas brgyan/ 'di ko gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyan min nam/ dge bas snga 'gyur bstan pa rgyas byed shog: ces pa'ang rang nyid kyi nyams su blang rgyur pad+ma ma ṇis bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// 51) ༄༅/ phur mjug bskang ba ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma rigs kyi bdag po ste// snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskang*// bud+dha zhe gnyis dus gsum dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang*// longs sku thugs rje chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas stong gi thugs= pad+ma thod phreng rig 'dzin brgyad// grub chen brgyad bcu'i= rje 'bangs nyer lnga so zur gnubs// gter ston brgya rtsa'i= rgyal bsen 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal// gur drag phur mjug= sgyu 'phrul drwa ba tshogs chen 'dus// rgyud sde'i lha tshogs= bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyi shu lnga/ sgrub sde'i lha tshogs= gnas mchog so gnyis yul nyer bzhi'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs= ma mgon gza' rdor spu gri sogs// dam can rgya mtsho'i= ga nā tshogs kyis thugs= bdud rtsi sman gyis= bā ling gtor mes= rak+ta dmar gyis= lta sgom spyod pas thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// phyi nang bar 52) chad zlog du gsol/ chags che nyam nga zlog du gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub du gsol/
oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ ga nā tsakra satwa sa ma ya= sogs yig brgya brjod/ ces pa 'phags pa a rā ga'i gsung la kha bsgyur ba'ang pad+ma ma ṇis so// dge'o//
